practice_questions.hint_1: What is the single most valuable alternative given up?
practice_questions.question:
You have two hours available. You can either: A) Study for an exam. B) Work a shift earning ₹400. C) Watch a movie. You choose to study. What is the opportunity cost of your decision?

A. The cost of your textbook
B. ₹400 and the value of the next-best alternative
C. The amount of time spent studying
D. Zero, because studying is free
